user.description: Set up at, a one-shot scheduler. No further configuration is needed.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of at is allowed.

init.title: at options
init.description: Tune how scheduled jobs are kept and how voice commands are handled. Changes apply right away; running jobs are not interrupted.

data.defer_relative_to_ha: Leave relative times to Home Assistant

data_description.grace_minutes: How many minutes late a job may still run after a restart or reload. Later jobs are marked missed. 0 to 1440.
data_description.history_days: How many days finished jobs stay in the history. 1 to 365.
data_description.history_max: The most finished jobs kept in the history. 1 to 10000.
data_description.panel_admin_only: Show the at sidebar panel only to administrators.
data_description.defer_relative_to_ha: Let Home Assistant handle phrases like "in 5 minutes" with its own timers instead of scheduling them here.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Schedules a command or an action to run once at a later time. Give either a command or an action, and one of at, delay or when.

command.name: Command
command.description: A sentence to run later, such as "turn on the porch light".

action.name: Action
action.description: An action to run later. Any user can schedule a single action; several steps or templates need an administrator.

at.name: At
at.description: The date and time to run it.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: How long from now to wait.

when.name: When
when.description: A time phrase such as "tomorrow at 7 am".

name.name: Name
name.description: A name to show instead of the generated summary.

list.name: List
list.description: Returns the scheduled jobs and the finished ones.

status.name: Status
status.description: Only include jobs in these states.

start.name: Start
start.description: Only include jobs due at or after this time.

end.name: End
end.description: Only include jobs due at or before this time.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: Cancels scheduled jobs by ID, or all of them.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: The ID of the job, or several IDs.

all.name: All
all.description: Cancel every scheduled job, including ones created by actions and automations.

run_now.name: Run now
run_now.description: Runs a scheduled job right away instead of at its due time.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: The ID of the job to run.

clear_history.name: Clear history
clear_history.description: Deletes every finished job from the history.

not_loaded.message: at is not set up. Add the integration first.

bad_time.message: "{when}" is not a time I understand.

unsupported_language.message: Time phrases are only available in English for now. Use at or delay instead.

job_not_found.message: No scheduled job has the ID {job_id}.

job_not_pending.message: Job {job_id} is not waiting to run, so it can't be changed.

summary_not_editable.message: Cancel and re-add to change a job.

panel.title: Scheduled Jobs
panel.update_needed: This panel needs an update for this Home Assistant version.
